name: sieve
description: Excludes files and folders before vault indexing.

scripts.test:core: npm run build:core && node scripts/run-tests.mjs Tests/Core/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:oracle: npm run build:core && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --oracle Tests/Oracle/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:regression: node scripts/run-tests.mjs Tests/*.test.mjs Tests/Adapters/*.test.mjs Tests/Settings/*.test.mjs Tests/SettingsUI/*.test.mjs Tests/I18n/*.test.mjs Tests/Alias/*.test.mjs
